records.fact: TOPLAS directs authors to ACM Manuscript Central and asks for a full ACM-style paper with appropriate citations.
records.title: ACM TOPLAS Submission Instructions
records.excerpt_or_faithful_paraphrase: Submit through ACM Manuscript Central; use a full paper with appropriate citations; prepare it in ACM LaTeX or Word style.

records.fact: A TOPLAS submission must include a cover letter documenting where any prior version of the material appeared.
records.title: ACM TOPLAS Submission Instructions
records.excerpt_or_faithful_paraphrase: The cover letter must document thesis, workshop, conference, or journal versions of the submitted material.

records.fact: If accepted, implementations, test programs, and source data may be included as supplemental material in the ACM Digital Library.
records.title: ACM TOPLAS Submission Instructions
records.excerpt_or_faithful_paraphrase: Accepted submissions may include implementations, test programs, and source data as digital-library supplemental material.

records.fact: The acmart 2.19 guide requires one structured author record per person and recommends repeating a shared affiliation after each author.
records.title: ACM acmart v2.19 documented source
records.excerpt_or_faithful_paraphrase: Each author has an independent author record; the basic fields are author, optional ORCID, structured affiliation, and email. Repeating a shared affiliation per author is the recommended form; institution, city, and country are mandatory.

records.fact: The acmart 2.19 guide provides the dedicated correspondingauthor command immediately after an author name and requires that author to have an email.
records.title: ACM acmart v2.19 documented source
records.excerpt_or_faithful_paraphrase: Place correspondingauthor after the author name; more than one corresponding author is allowed, and the corresponding author must have an email.

records.fact: ACM review manuscripts use the single-column manuscript layout; the review option supplies continuous line numbers.

records.excerpt_or_faithful_paraphrase: Use manuscript mode for review; review mode adds line numbers; production output is a separate stage.
